title: Glowing teapot
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="42" ry="26" fill="#2a1a00" opacity="0.6"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="32" ry="20" fill="#5a3a00" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Saucer -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="84" rx="36" ry="8" fill="#b06a1a"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="82" rx="34" ry="7" fill="#d98a2a"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="80" rx="28" ry="5" fill="#f0a83a"/>

  <!-- Spout -->
  <path d="M76 52 Q90 48 94 38 Q95 34 92 33 Q89 33 88 37 Q85 46 74 50 Z" fill="#e07820" stroke="#ffb84a" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M78 54 Q88 50 90 41 Q90 39 88 39" fill="none" stroke="#ffd070" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Handle -->
  <path d="M22 48 Q8 44 6 56 Q4 68 20 68" fill="none" stroke="#e07820" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M22 48 Q10 45 8 56 Q7 66 20 67" fill="none" stroke="#ffb84a" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Handle glow -->
  <path d="M20 50 Q12 48 11 56 Q10 63 19 65" fill="none" stroke="#ffe08a" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- Teapot body -->
  <ellipse cx="49" cy="62" rx="30" ry="24" fill="#e07820"/>
  <ellipse cx="49" cy="60" rx="30" ry="23" fill="#f08c2a"/>
  <!-- Body shading -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="56" rx="14" ry="10" fill="#ffa84a" opacity="0.6"/>
  <ellipse cx="49" cy="66" rx="24" ry="14" fill="#d96a18" opacity="0.4"/>

  <!-- Glow highlight on body -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="52" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#ffe08a" opacity="0.4"/>

  <!-- Lid rim -->
  <rect x="30" y="38" width="38" height="6" rx="3" fill="#c85f14"/>
  <rect x="31" y="38" width="36" height="3" rx="2" fill="#ff9c38"/>

  <!-- Lid dome -->
  <path d="M32 40 Q34 30 49 29 Q64 30 66 40 Z" fill="#f08c2a"/>
  <path d="M34 39 Q36 32 49 31 Q62 32 64 39 Z" fill="#ffa84a"/>

  <!-- Knob -->
  <ellipse cx="49" cy="29" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#ffe08a"/>
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="28" rx="2" ry="1.5" fill="#fff6c0"/>

  <!-- Steam wisps -->
  <path d="M40 24 Q37 18 40 14 Q43 10 40 6" fill="none" stroke="#ffd060" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7"/>
  <path d="M49 22 Q46 16 49 12 Q52 8 49 4" fill="none" stroke="#ffd060" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.8"/>
  <path d="M58 24 Q55 18 58 14 Q61 10 58 6" fill="none" stroke="#ffd060" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- Decorative dots on body -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="62" r="2" fill="#ffe08a" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="49" cy="60" r="2" fill="#ffe08a" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="62" r="2" fill="#ffe08a" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="70" r="1.5" fill="#ffd070" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="54" cy="70" r="1.5" fill="#ffd070" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Warm glow lines -->
  <path d="M30 50 Q26 58 30 68" fill="none" stroke="#ffcc60" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.4"/>
  <path d="M68 50 Q72 58 68 68" fill="none" stroke="#ffcc60" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.4"/>
</svg>
